system.description: The spirit conjurer calls on the power of the mastomant spirit, and a pair of half-meter-long tusks emerges from their jaw. The dimwalker can use these tusks in unarmed fighting, dealing 1d10 points of damage. An attack with the tusks counts as a bonus attack, though the character must still spend Combat Points as a standard attack to determine the Situation value. The spirit conjurer can attempt only one attack with the tusks per action round.
